description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Lissandra''' can cast ''Frozen Tomb'' on herself or an enemy champion.
description.text: Active: Lissandra can cast Frozen Tomb on herself or an enemy champion.

description2.raw: '''Enemy Cast:''' '''Lissandra''' freezes the target enemy champion, [[File:Knockdown icon.png|20px|link=Knockdown|An icon representing the keyword Knockdown]] [[:Knockdown|knocking them down]] and [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stunning]] them for 1.5 seconds.
description2.text: Enemy Cast: Lissandra freezes the target enemy champion, knocking them down and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

description3.raw: '''Self Cast:''' '''Lissandra''' instantly entombs herself in ice, entering [[File:Stasis icon.png|20px|link=Invulnerability#Stasis|An icon representing the keyword Stasis (buff)]] [[:Invulnerability#Stasis|stasis]] for 2.5 seconds and [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|healing]] herself every 0.25 seconds over the duration. The healing is increased by 0% – 100% (based on '''missing''' health at the time of cast)[[Category:Debug]].
description3.text: Self Cast: Lissandra instantly entombs herself in ice, entering stasis for 2.5 seconds and healing herself every 0.25 seconds over the duration. The healing is increased by 0% – 100% (based on missing health at the time of cast)Category:Debug.

description4.raw: ''Frozen Tomb'' creates a field of ice that spreads out from the target over 1.5 seconds and covers the surrounding area for 3 seconds, dealing magic damage to enemies and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowing]] them for 0.5 seconds, refreshing every 0.25 seconds while they remain.
description4.text: Frozen Tomb creates a field of ice that spreads out from the target over 1.5 seconds and covers the surrounding area for 3 seconds, dealing magic damage to enemies and slowing them for 0.5 seconds, refreshing every 0.25 seconds while they remain.

notes.raw: * Enemies can only be damaged by the field of ice once every 4 seconds. ** Under normal circumstances, this means once per cast of ''Frozen Tomb''. * Enemies who come in contact with ''Frozen Tomb's'' slow field will be damaged and a small visual and sound effect will play. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will block the single-targeted portion and the radiating ice damage, but will not stop it from spreading. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost. ** The ability is not cancelled by loss of [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the target. ** This only applies to the enemy cast. * When becoming [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], '''Lissandra''' [[File:Bullet strikethrough.png|20px|link=Projectile|An icon representing the keyword Homing projectile destruction]] [[:Projectile|destroys]] enemy projectiles targeting her.
notes.text:
Enemies can only be damaged by the field of ice once every 4 seconds.
* Under normal circumstances, this means once per cast of Frozen Tomb.
Enemies who come in contact with Frozen Tomb's slow field will be damaged and a small visual and sound effect will play.
Spell shield will block the single-targeted portion and the radiating ice damage, but will not stop it from spreading.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost.
* The ability is not cancelled by loss of sight of the target.
* This only applies to the enemy cast.
When becoming untargetable, Lissandra destroys enemy projectiles targeting her.
